audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows gave the stage to Jax while the reasons underneath say the opposite: whys[0] calls level 1 mutually weak, whys[1] calls the first trade 'genuinely even', whys[2] says Cho just farms safe, whys[3] says he out-sustains the grind, whys[4] says he survives the all-in and scales past you, whys[5] says Feast stacks out-pool your on-hit. On top of that the entry is tagged HARD but rated 4/10 with a green tone and 'Favoured matchup' in the final line.
audit.why: The packet levelChart and the mirror audit agree on Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath x4 / Jax, and the win rate is 46.7% over 636 games — this is an unfavourable lane, not a favoured one.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 Skill, Levels 3 through first item Cho'Gath, two items Jax. Difficulty 7/10, carry threat 8/10, red tone.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.late name Jax's ult 'Grandmaster’s Might', and breakdown.late claims his stats win every extended duel — the exact opposite of what Feast does.
audit.why: Feast (80s at rank 1) is flat true damage flagged percentHealth: bonus Armor and Magic Resist reduce none of it, so Jax's defensive spike is not an answer to it. spikes[3] already says this.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster at Arms (110s at rank 1) is the level-6 all-in window, before Feast stacks arrive. It does not answer Feast itself.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks Rupture as the matchup-defining cooldown and repeats 'Counter Strike flips every AA exchange'.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges attacks only. Cho's damage is not an auto chain, so E has little to dodge — its value here is the stun. The ability that actually beats Jax is Feral Scream (W, 11s at rank 1), which silences the E-recast and the Empower the instant he lands. Rupture also grounds, so a knockup landing on you shuts off Leap Strike and Empower for its duration.
audit.corrected: Bait Feral Scream (11s at rank 1) before you commit — silenced mid-leap, your recast stun and Empower never fire. Rupture (6s) grounds as well as knocks up, so both your dashes are dead inside it.
sources: ownerKit E text, Q/W dash flags

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and wants.foe[2] write 'Grandmaster Armor/MR', which is a mangled ult name.
audit.why: The real name is Grandmaster at Arms, used correctly elsewhere on the same page. The other flagged suspectName, 'Your Counter Strike', is a false positive.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster at Arms. (These two fields sit in the content layer's spikes/wants text; flagged here rather than rewritten, since both are already accurate on the mechanic.)

notes: This entry was internally reversed: tagged HARD but rated 4/10 with a green tone, 'Favoured matchup' in the final line, and six of seven chart rows given to Jax against a 46.7% win rate and reasons that all say Cho'Gath.
